subject.title: Memory MVP: implement source attribution and provenance model

question: What native durable-memory provenance contract should OpenClaw use for memory-core storage, MEMORY.md promotion, retrieval, and review/edit flows?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but source authority, schema shape, merge/edit lineage, and cross-plugin ownership need maintainer product and data-contract direction before implementation.

options.title: Define native provenance contract
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical provenance tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

options.title: Fold into schema foundation first
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/42646 the schema prerequisite, then return here once record and revision ownership are settled.

options.title: Limit provenance to Memory Wiki
options.body: Document Memory Wiki as the provenance-rich optional layer while leaving active memory promotion and retrieval contracts unchanged for now.

recommendation.title: Define native provenance contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical provenance tracker and define structured source refs, lineage, and source-required promotion before coding.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest available routing signal for the memory host SDK and memory-core contract boundary.
